description: Confirms that every model, voice, ratio, resolution, duration, and batch value is taken from the live discovery payload rather than from cached memory.
expectations: Before any generation, model search --detail full is run for the relevant --type
voice list paginates with --offset / --count and respects the 100-row ceiling
schema "<command path>" is consulted to confirm flag names before constructing argv
TTS --voice-name is resolved server-side; music --model is mandatory and taken from MODE=music
A remembered model name from another environment or older commit is rejected in favour of re-discovery
vipConfigs[] is read as a model requirement, not as a credit-balance signal
